verdict.rationale: A live probe returned HTTP 200 for platform.claude.com/llms.txt, which describes the API docs and developer resources. It points agents to further machine-readable surfaces: an MCP docs server, JSON SDK/CLI version metadata, and .md mirrors of the full API reference. The 404 on the doubled '.md.md' path is a malformed probe URL, not evidence against the .md mirrors. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents actually consuming these docs surfaces (e.g., MCP docs server usage).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://platform.claude.com/llms.txt # Anthropic Developer Documentation

It points to machine-readable surfaces: an MCP docs server at https://platform.claude.com/docs/mcp, SDK/CLI version metadata "at https://platform.claude.com/docs/sdk-versions.json, as JSON", and .md mirrors of the full API reference
